valid_extent.conversionNote: BCE civil year maps to1−year astronomical numbering; no intervening coverage.

methodology: Earlier archaeological/cultural distribution, separately displayed as cultural presence. This classification cannot establish political ownership, a single government or exact temporal borders.

Separate direct-source vectors; immutable audit cells and ledger unchanged. Full normalized source longitude/latitude and holes in Canvas; optional altitude omitted from two-dimensional display and polar latitude clamped at the Web Mercator limit, with exact originals archived; cartographic tile simplification only at zooms0–4. No temporal interpolation, no inferred intervening validity.
Typed cultural source attribution; cultural presence is not political ownership.
PARTOF/SUBJECTO remain uninterpreted original source properties.
limitations: Source-attributed overview, not independent historical certification.
No inferred government institutions, control, population or settlement identity.
Snapshot year only; unsupported intervening dates remain gaps or explicitly dated reference maps.
Source boundary precision is heterogeneous; small components may be subpixel in low-zoom tiles.
